mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, unit_id, progress, streak_days, updated_at FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND unit_id = #{unitId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_progress (user_id, unit_id, progress, streak_days, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{unitId}, #{progress}, #{streakDays}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE progress = VALUES(progress), streak_days = VALUES(streak_days), updated_at = NOW()
